correctness.rationale: Unrolling SGD yields an exact strictly convex quadratic in feasible cumulative oracle weights. Toeplitz AR(1) inverse is explicit and positive definite for |rho|<1; its unconstrained unique minimizer has strictly positive weights of sum less than one and maps injectively back to steps in (0,1). Adjacent comparisons reduce exactly to signs of t+rho(1+rho) and rho(1+rho)-t P_N(rho). Rational-verifier recurrence and independent numerical optimization tested multiple parameters. Finite checks do not substitute for the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The motivating recent exact-schedule study proves decreasing optimal steps under martingale gradient noise. This natural scalar model provides a complete sharp boundary when equal-variance but temporally correlated gradient samples break that assumption. It distinguishes negative-correlation first-step rebound from positive-correlation terminal-step rebound, with horizon-independent versus horizon-dependent thresholds and exact rational witnesses. This is a motivated schedule-design limit, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a claim of general algorithms improvement.
